messages:
alex: Quick sync — I have PR #14223 ready but it hits a flaky test on the mac matrix. Prefer to land today if we can avoid the weekend deploy freeze. Can people weigh in on timing?

morgan: pinging @sam and @jordan for reviews. I had one small comment about the feature flag naming but otherwise looks ok.

sam: I can take a pass in 30m. if the CI greenlight comes first, happy to approve post-merge + revert if anything slips. :+1: 

ci-bot: CI status: mac-11-x64 failed (1 test).
Failure snippet: `tests/runtime/test_cache.py::test_kv_eviction - AssertionError: expected 3, got 2`

jordan: That mac flake is the one we've been seeing intermittently. Rebase doesn't usually fix it. Might need a retry of that job or to pin the test to a slower runner.

alex: Hmm. Can we rerun that job now? If it fails again, is the plan to hold until the rebase window tomorrow morning (UTC)? I don't want to force a merge that triggers a rollback during freeze.

release-coordinator: FYI deploy freeze starts in 14 hours. We can still land things that are low risk and tiny, but coordinate with SRE for canary if hitting flaky infra.

morgan: @ci-bot can you rerun mac-11-x64 for PR-14223?

ci-bot: Rerun queued. Job ID: 98765.

ci-bot: CI status: mac-11-x64 passed ✅

sam: I looked through the diffs. Approving now. Two nits left, but not blocking. Approving: `review.approved`

jordan: I recommend adding a short canary flag. If we see errors post-merge we can rollback the flag quickly without a ship rollback. small tweak but safe.

alex: Good call. I'll add the flag in a follow-up PR and keep this one focused. Planning to merge after 10 more minutes of eyes. If no objections, merging at `2026-03-18T16:30:00Z` (approx).

morgan: Sounds good. I'll watch the canary metrics. Tag me if latency or errors spike.

release-coordinator: Noted. If any unexpected rollout issues, hit #eng-oncall and we'll pause traffic to the region.

alex: Merged. Thanks all. :tada:

ci-bot: Merge completed. PR #14223 -> main.

morgan: Watching post-merge canary now, everything looks stable so far.

jordan: Thanks — great job moving this through without blocking the freeze.

alex: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will open the feature-flag follow-up shortly.
